how.title: How we choose
how.spoiling: We look at products that spoil in the coming hours and days — the sooner and the more, the more important.

how.canCook: We only show what the kitchen can cook right now: dishes on the stop list are left out.
how.live: The list recalculates itself after every order, delivery and write-off.
how.overstock: If there is more of a product than sells in a few days and it doesn't keep long, dishes with it go into the second group.
